location_exception_reason: Greenhouse design services are nationwide commodities delivered by regional contractors; location in titles is seller geography, not a buyer decision factor. Agro-climatic zone (which affects design) is a specification, not a location name.
biz_exception_reason: Service-type words ('Design Services', 'Consultancy', 'Turnkey Project', 'DPR Preparation') are integral to what is being sold — they define the scope of engagement (design-only vs. full construction vs. consultancy). Removing them leaves the title incomplete and ambiguous about service scope.
